title: Tool Credential Config
description: Declares the credential fields one tool needs, resolved through tools/lib/resolve-credential.cjs.

tool.description: Tool directory name, for diagnostics only.

envVar.description: Environment variable name to check first. Defaults to the field's own key.

opField.description: 1Password field label, or an array of candidate labels to try in order.

envFileKey.description: Key to look for in an env file. Defaults to envVar.

required.description: Whether resolution failure should throw. Set false for optional fields.

description.description: Human-readable note for SETUP.md / env.example generation.
